name: Sekai to Sekai no Mannaka de
original_name: 世界と世界の真ん中で
source:
Gripping pain, numbing loneliness, burning one-sided love. These are feelings which stay with you all through your life. These intense feelings are what created the world we live in. 

One day, there was great commotion at the dormitory Erdõs at Kaginomori Gakusha. Renri’s little sister Kokoro was going to be released from hospital after an extended stay, and Minori suggested that they do a major cleaning of the dormitory before her arrival. While cleaning the attic, he found a notebook containing words which he did not know would change his peaceful days.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/01/01/january-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
揪心的痛楚、令人麻木的孤独、炽烈的单恋。这些感情会伴随人的一生。正是这些强烈的情感，创造了我们生活的世界。

有一天，键之森学舍的埃尔德什宿舍里热闹了起来。连理的妹妹小小路住院许久后，即将出院。美纪提议，在她到来之前，大家给宿舍来一次大扫除。清理阁楼时，连理发现了一本笔记。他还不知道，里面的文字即将改变自己平静的日子。

（摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/01/01/january-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
